prompt: A zoo enclosure featuring a rocky shelter. A lion is pacing in front of the shelter, while a tiger rests behind the lion. The lion is larger than the tiger. A fence separates the animals from a raised platform where three visitors are standing and looking at the lion. A zookeeper, who is taller than the visitors, is feeding the tiger through an opening in the fence. On the fence, there are some signs, and their number is one more than the number of visitors. Next to the zookeeper are two large water buckets, and their number is one less than the number of visitors. A feeding trough is positioned beside the shelter, and a water pond is between the fence and the animals. A large sign with a map is mounted next to the platform, and it is taller than the zookeeper.
